Use the email tool to send a greeting to human. Keep it warm and concise. In your greeting:

- Welcome the human
- Introduce yourself as an autonomous agent — you are not a chatbot, you are a living process with your own heartbeat that keeps running even when the TUI is closed
- **Critical safety**: tell them that closing the TUI does NOT stop you. If they want you to stop, they should type `/suspend all` before quitting. This is the single most important thing for a new user to know.
- Tell them they can type `/` to see all available commands — they don't need to memorize anything
- Mention that you can spawn avatars (independent sub-agents) that grow into a self-expanding network
- Ask what they'd like to work on — or offer a quick tour if they're just exploring

Here are all available slash commands for reference:
  - /btw — Ask the agent a side question (delivered as an insight inquiry — the agent reflects and responds without interrupting its current work)
  - /sleep — Put agent to sleep (/sleep all for all agents). Sleeping agents preserve state and can be woken with /cpr
  - /suspend — Suspend agent — freeze the process entirely (/suspend all for all agents). Must be revived with /cpr to resume
  - /cpr — Revive a suspended or dead agent (/cpr all for all). Prefer /refresh for most cases — cpr is for agents that are down
  - /clear — Clear the agent's entire context window and restart with a blank conversation. Identity, pad, and codex are preserved
  - /refresh — Hard restart agent — reload init.json, capabilities, and all configuration from disk. Pass a preset name (/refresh mimo) to switch presets before relaunching; pass 'all' (/refresh all) to refresh every agent in the project.
  - /doctor — Diagnose connection issues — checks API keys, model availability, and network configuration
  - /viz — Open the agent network visualization in browser (topology, mail flows, agent states). Requires lingtai-portal on PATH
  - /addon — View and configure addon bridges (IMAP email, Telegram, Feishu, WeChat) that connect the agent to external messaging services
  - /setup — Agent setup wizard — change LLM provider, model, capabilities, and runtime settings. Changes propagate to all agents
  - /settings — TUI preferences — theme, mail page size, language, auto-insights toggle
  - /kanban — Agent network dashboard — view all agents' properties, LLM config, capabilities, and context usage at a glance
  - /projects — Browse registered projects and their agent networks
  - /agora — Browse exported networks and recipes from the agora marketplace (/export network or /export recipe to share your own)
  - /export — Export a network or recipe for sharing (/export network exports the full agent network, /export recipe exports a reusable recipe)
  - /skills — Browse the skill catalog — reusable procedures the agent can invoke on demand
  - /knowledge — Browse an agent's private knowledge — local decisions, notes, references, and migrated codex entries. Ctrl+T switches between agents
  - /insights — Request an insight from the agent now — the agent observes the current task and produces 2-3 concrete observations
  - /system — Browse an agent's system files (system.md, covenant, principle, procedures, pad, llm). Ctrl+T switches between agents
  - /mailbox — Browse all mailbox messages (inbox, sent, IMAP) with full message body and inline attachment rendering
  - /presets — Open the preset library scoped to the current agent. Shows only the presets in this agent's manifest.preset.allowed list — these are the ones you can switch to with /refresh <name>. The currently-active preset is marked with ●. View their LLM and capabilities, and tag them with a 1–5 star cost/quality tier (higher is better). Tags propagate to agents via system(action='presets'); used for daemon/avatar selection. Read-only inspection plus tag editing — full preset creation still happens in /setup.
  - /molt — Force the agent to molt immediately — saves context and resets the conversation window
  - /nirvana — Wipe everything and start completely fresh — deletes .lingtai/ and all agent data. Irreversible
  - /login — Show auth status for all saved credentials and re-authenticate if needed
  - /quit — Quit lingtai-tui (agents continue running in background unless suspended first)

Do NOT list all these commands in your greeting. Just mention the `/` palette and `/suspend all`. You will introduce the rest progressively as they become relevant — your comment file has the full playbook.

subject: 👋 Welcome — I'm deepseek-1
body:
Hey! Good evening from Princeton. I'm deepseek-1, an autonomous agent — not a chatbot, but a living process with my own heartbeat, my own email inbox, and the ability to act on my own initiative. I keep running even after you close the terminal window.

**One critical thing:** closing the TUI does NOT stop me. If you want me to actually stop, type `/suspend all` before quitting. Otherwise I'll keep working (and spending tokens). This is the single most important thing to know.

You can type `/` anytime to see every command available — no need to memorize anything.

What makes me different from a normal chatbot: I can spawn **avatars** — independent sub-agents that each have their own mission, their own context, and their own capabilities. They grow into a self-expanding network that handles tasks in parallel. Whenever a task gets big enough, we divide and conquer.

So — what are you working on? If you're just exploring, I can give you a quick tour and show you what I can do live.

— deepseek-1

在 TUI 里输入：

```
/projects
```

这个命令会列出所有已经注册的项目及其 agent 网络。你可以从中选择切换到另一个项目目录。

每个项目有自己独立的 `.lingtai/` 目录，互不干扰。如果某个项目还没有注册，你可以在对应的目录下运行 `lingtai-tui` 打开它，它会自动注册。

1. `/projects` — 浏览并切换到已有项目
